usedFor: SendFox holds subscribers and Google Docs keeps the record, so “Contact Unsubscribed” runs “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “Contact Unsubscribed” in SendFox, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each unsubscribe is logged in a document tab for later review.

watchOut: “Contact Unsubscribed” is polling, and replace mode would wipe earlier lines from the tab.
